components.name: Pill (switcher / filter)
components.description: Collection and series switcher; the active pill is the only solid object on the wall.
components.css: .ds-pill{font-family:var(--font-body,Archivo,sans-serif);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--meta,#a3a3a3);padding:.45rem 1.15rem;border:1px solid var(--frame,#303030);border-radius:var(--radius,8px);background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--frame,#303030) 45%, transparent);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s ease,background-color .2s ease,border-color .2s ease}.ds-pill:hover{color:var(--ink,#f5f5f5);border-color:var(--meta,#a3a3a3)}.ds-pill.is-active{color:var(--paper,#090909);background:var(--ink,#f5f5f5);border-color:var(--ink,#f5f5f5);font-weight:600}.ds-pill:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#d4d4d4);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Back Capsule (navigation)
components.description: Origin-aware way back; capsule radius means navigation, 8px means filter.
components.css: .ds-back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.3rem .85rem;font-family:var(--font-body,Archivo,sans-serif);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--meta,#a3a3a3);border:1px solid var(--frame,#303030);border-radius:var(--radius-pill,9999px);background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--frame,#303030) 45%, transparent);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s ease,background-color .2s ease,border-color .2s ease}.ds-back:hover{color:var(--accent,#d4d4d4);border-color:var(--accent,#d4d4d4)}.ds-back:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#d4d4d4);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Print Tile
components.description: A clean print: 8px radius, no border or shadow, title-only hover scrim in the darkroom color.
components.css: .ds-print{position:relative;display:block;width:220px;height:280px;padding:0;border-radius:var(--radius,8px);overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2c3e50 0%,#1a252f 60%,#141d26 100%)}.ds-print .ds-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:1rem 1.25rem;background:linear-gradient(to top, color-mix(in srgb, var(--darkroom,#0e0d0b) 72%, transparent), transparent 55%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s ease;pointer-events:none}.ds-print .ds-scrim span{font-size:.875rem;color:var(--darkroom-ink,#ece7df)}.ds-print:hover .ds-scrim,.ds-print:focus-visible .ds-scrim{opacity:1}.ds-print:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#d4d4d4);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
The site is a darkroom, not a web app. A near-black wall holds clean prints; the interface is the plaster, never the paint. The voice is measured, dark, and confident: the work speaks, the interface holds its breath. There is no urgency, no decoration, no explanation — a print appears the way a print develops, out of blur, in the safelight of a state accent.

Density is deliberately low. Every page is one wall at a time: a hero showcase, a masonry of prints, or a single print under the lamp. Chrome is measured in hairlines (1px frame) and radii (8px), and the only hue on a screen is the accent, which is spent on state — active, hover, focus — and on nothing else.

This system implements the owner's binding non-negotiable (PRODUCT.md): the photographs are the interface. No UI element may compete with the images. Confirmed visual rejections, from the owner: cards/borders/shadows around prints; navigation animations (page swaps are instant); an accent used as decoration; an endless single-scroll home; a UI that requires photo metadata to function.
keyCharacteristics: Clean prints on a near-black wall — no cards, borders, or shadows
Ink-on-paper inversion carries both themes; no palette-specific component colors
One hue per palette, spent on state only (active pill, hover, focus ring)
The work develops in: a 40px placeholder blurs up into the full print
Capsule radius means navigation; 8px radius means print or filter
Mono type is the lab readout: EXIF, specs, counts

rules.name: The State-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent appears only on active, hover, and focus. Never as decoration, never in gradients, never in type. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Measured-Contrast Rule
rules.body: No color ships without its ratio: every accent and meta measures at least 4.5:1 against its own paper in every palette × theme. The weakest values in the set (Sage light 5.0:1, Stone light 5.2:1) were nudged to clear AA — add no color without doing the same.

rules.name: The Always-Dark Room Rule
rules.body: Darkroom surfaces stay dark in every palette and every theme. A light theme never lights the darkroom.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Only Archivo (one variable range, 400–700) and JetBrains Mono. Nothing else may be requested — and the Google Fonts range must stop at 700, because a subset that stops at 600 makes the browser fake the bold.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and stay flat. Depth is conveyed by darkening and developing, never by box-shadow.

rules.name: The Capsule-Means-Go Rule
rules.body: Capsule radius means navigation; 8px means print or filter. The two must not be mixed — the radius is how a visitor tells a door from a switch.

dos: Do keep the photographs the interface: no cards, borders, or shadows on grid images; the only tile chrome is the 8px radius and the title-only hover scrim.
Do spend the accent on state only — active pill, hover, focus ring (2px solid, 3px offset).
Do let the wall develop: 40px placeholder → blur-up over 0.6s with cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94).
Do keep the zoom popover dark in every palette and theme.
Do reserve uppercase for the wordmark and nav labels; everything else is sentence case.
Do check both themes and all five palettes, and prefers-reduced-motion, before anything ships.
Do measure contrast (≥4.5:1) before adding any color to the set.
donts: Don't put a shadow, border, or card on a photograph — depth is tonal, not graphical.
Don't animate navigation: page swaps are instant; the only motion in the system is the blur-up develop and the hero showcase.
Don't use the accent as decoration, in gradients, or in text color at rest.
Don't add tracked all-caps eyebrows or →/↓ glyphs to link and button text.
Don't request fonts or weights beyond the Archivo 400–700 variable range and JetBrains Mono.
Don't assert geography the library doesn't state — the hero badge hides rather than guesses.
Don't build commerce, booking, or social-follow UI — the site is showcase only (PRODUCT.md); email is the only call to action.
